mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the last month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increases do not correlate with subsequent negative GDP growth (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining HOUST, or HOUST declines do not precede GDP declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent GDP growth (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not predict negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not predict positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decreases do not correlate with subsequent GDP declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is increasing and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy supporting supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with supply growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS does not predict positive returns (p > 0.05).
